what: Main GPU model research 2026-10-12: optimized Qwen3.6-35B-A3B vs Qwen3.8-27B (plan docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-12-main-model-qwen36-vs-qwen38.md)

serving_qwen36.bench: LXC 151, llama.cpp b11026, both V620s, layer split 1,1, ub 1024, f16 KV, FA auto, ctx 65536, thinking off, embed + rerank resident; 700-token outputs, prompts: code (temp 0 and 0.7) and a 7.7K-token RAG context, two reps each
failures: Unsloth MTP UD-Q4_K_XL: ROCm illegal memory access on the first request, with or without MTP (4 of 4 attempts)
plain UD-Q6_K runs at layer 1:1 (57.7 t/s); its earlier crash was specific to layer 1:1.5
serving_qwen36.chosen: UD-Q6_K_XL + draft-mtp n-max 3: 1.6x the old Q4 generation at a higher-quality quant; costs ~25% prefill. Used for every Qwen3.6 quality run below.
serving_qwen36.vs_published: Unsloth/community report 1.15-1.25x for MTP on this MoE on NVIDIA; measured 1.6-1.8x over MTP-off at the same quant here (110-119 vs 67 code, 112 vs 64 RAG).

polyglot_python34.setup: Aider Polyglot Python-34, whole edit format, --threads 1, aider sends temperature 0 (as in every earlier run); LXC 158 -> direct llama-server in 151 (gpu-q36.sh: Q6_K_XL + MTP n3, 1 x 128K)

qwen36_nothink.incident: case 31 (forth) fell into a temperature-0 repetition loop: 52K+ tokens on one request with no client max_tokens; aider timed out and retried behind it. The server was restarted at 19:03Z with --n-predict 32768 so a loop fails fast; no real answer comes near that cap, so the score is unaffected (a loop never passes). All later runs use the cap.

polyglot_python34.reading_so_far: Qwen3.6 think 76.5 vs qwen3.8 think 73.5 (Sept): +3 points = one case, inside noise. Qwen3.6 is NOT faster here: 124.5 vs 111.8 s/case -- it generates ~1.6x faster per token but reasons longer. Per the plan (within 10 points) qwen3.8-think is re-run the same day: queued after lt-9-s38 (run py34-q38think-rerun).

qwen36_think.server: same Q6_K_XL + MTP n3, enable_thinking true, server sampling 0.6/0.95/20 (aider overrides temperature to 0), --n-predict 32768

rag_frozen_retrieval.setup: 22 answerable VCF questions (rag_questions.json), vcf-reference vector-search top-6 frozen once, workspace system prompt, non-thinking, identical explicit sampling 0.7/0.8/20 presence 1.5, max_tokens 1500. Qwen3.6 = gpu-q36.sh Q6_K_XL + MTP n3 direct; qwen3.8 = router alias qwen3.8-nothink (production chat, window 3-slot layout), no other load.
rag_frozen_retrieval.grading: blind: 4 batches, X/Y labels randomised per question (seed 20261012), key kept apart until all grades were in; 4 Opus graders judged each answer against the frozen context only (2 correct+supported, 1 partly/unsupported claim, 0 wrong or unjustified refusal).
qwen36_failure_modes: unjustified refusal 'Not in the provided VCF documents.' when the context held the answer (q08 component table, q09 certificate replacement)

claims the context does not support or contradicts: invented menu names (q12), VCF Automation and Identity Broker called core components (q20), 'VCF Automation does not need a Supervisor' where the context requires one (q16)
rag_frozen_retrieval.decision_clause: FAILS: Qwen3.6 has 5 fewer fully correct answers than qwen3.8 (12 vs 17); the clause allows at most 2. Qwen3.6 answers 2.9x faster.

workforce_arm_s.setup: the 16 frozen W2 tasks, hidden-test grading, harness 03b1dff, GPU implementer alone, non-thinking. Qwen3.6 = transient Q4_K_M server (no MTP; the S runs predate the MTP bench); qwen3.8 = router qwen3.8-nothink on the production chat (3-slot window layout, MTP n3).
workforce_arm_s.reading: Equal acceptance (13 vs 12-15). Qwen3.6 is 1.5x faster (33 vs 49 min) even WITHOUT MTP; with Q6+MTP its generation is ~1.6x faster again, so the real gap is likely larger (not measured). Run format: [accepted of 16, minutes].
